jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Data Center Engineering team designs training and inference compute clusters from first principles, pushing thermal, electrical, and optical systems to the limit of physics. We operate as a highly cross disciplinary team comprised of mechanical, electrical, optical, and software engineers, all working to maximize the efficiency, reliability, and deployment speed of terrestrial computing to serve rapidly scaling demand.

This team owns compute architecture, datacenter network design, rack builds, connectivity, in-house design of our own computers, and the manufacturing line that builds that compute. As a Rack Design Engineer, you will own the rack as a product: structure, power, cooling, service paths, and the physical integration of servers, switches, optics, and liquid cooling from first sketch through production rate.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own mechanical, structural, and integration design of high-density AI compute racks and associated chassis, frames, busbars, manifolds, and cable/fiber raceways
• Integrate compute, networking, power distribution, and liquid cooling into a buildable, serviceable, high-yield rack architecture
• Design for the in-house manufacturing line: DFM/DFA, fixtures, work instructions, incoming inspection, first article, and production ramp
• Close thermal, structural, and power constraints with cooling, electrical, optical, and network counterparts at the cluster level (CDUs, cold plates, quick disconnects, PDUs/busbars, high-current distribution, tray and bend-radius limits)
• Drive vendor and in-house parts from concept to qualified production, including sheet metal, extrusions, busbar, manifolds, cable management, and rack accessories
• Stand on the floor during prototype and production builds: debug fit, leak, cable dress, airflow/liquid balance, and service time; fold issues into the next revision the same day
• Produce and maintain CAD, BOMs, drawings, and build documentation that a line can run at volume
• Support cluster deployment of the racks you design, including first-site bring-up and feedback into the next hardware generation
• Partner with network, optical, electrical, and firmware teams to deploy custom compute for inference and training across SpaceX programs

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related engineering discipline
• 2+ years of professional experience designing electromechanical hardware that was built and shipped (internship and project experience counts toward this if the hardware was physically produced)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Ownership of rack, chassis, or similarly dense electromechanical products through prototype and production
• Experience or background in ethernet switching, networking, interconnects, and high power distribution
• CAD fluency in SolidWorks, Creo, or NX, with released drawings a shop and a factory can build from
• AI / HPC / GPU rack design: NVIDIA HGX/GB-class, custom OCP, or equivalent high-power liquid-cooled compute
• Liquid cooling design: cold plates, manifolds, CDUs, quick disconnects, leak detection, and coolant compatibility
• High-power rack electrical integration: busbar, PDU, 48V, high-current 3-phase, grounding, and service safety
• Cable and fiber physical design inside the rack (MPO/OSFP dress, bend radius, service loops) in partnership with optical and network engineers
• Experience taking a rack from NPI onto an in-house manufacturing line (fixtures, cycle time, poka-yoke, rework loops)
• Thermal and structural analysis (CFD, FEA) used to make a design decision
• Time at a high-velocity hardware organization: AI/GPU cloud, custom compute, or an OEM/ODM team that owned the product end to end
• Comfort in a factory or datacenter build environment, including first articles, yield, and hardware debug on the floor

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support design releases, line bring-up, and cluster deployments
• Must be willing to travel to manufacturing and datacenter sites
• Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted and work around active factory and datacenter hardware

You will work closely with mechanical, structural, electrical, and operations teams to rig, signal, and set loads from construction through turnover. This is a full-time, onsite role with significant travel to SpaceXAI data center sites.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Plan and execute lifts using mobile and tower cranes (as signal person), forklifts, gantries, tuggers, chain falls, come-alongs, and other hoisting equipment.
• Inspect, select, and install slings, shackles, spreader bars, below-the-hook devices, and other rigging hardware; confirm working load limits, hitch type, and sling angles before a pick.
• Keep damaged, unlabeled, or out-of-date gear out of service and maintain an orderly rigging crib and laydown yard.
• Signal crane and forklift operators and run the lift team communication for the duration of the pick, including exclusion zones.
• Crib, block, roll, and land pumps, cooling towers, air handlers, skids, pipe racks, modules, and other mechanical gear.
• Assist with simple lift sketches, load paths, and field changes; flag drawing or lift-plan conflicts before the pick starts.
• Stage, move, and inventory rigging gear and construction materials; fetch and return tools and keep consumables stocked.
• Open and close work areas: protection, debris removal, scrap segregation, and end-of-shift reset so the next crew can start immediately.
• Follow LOTO, PPE, lift-permit, and site rules; do not start a lift without authorization and a clear exclusion zone.
• Report damaged gear, unsafe conditions, and near misses immediately.
• Support punch-list work and cleanup through system turnover.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Journey-level construction rigging experience: 3+ years of industrial or commercial construction rigging, completion of a recognized rigger or ironworker apprenticeship, or equivalent military experience.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience signaling cranes and executing lifts with slings, shackles, chain falls, come-alongs, and gantries or tuggers.
• Willingness to work at heights, outdoors, and on a changing data center construction site.
• Ability to use hand tools, power tools, and material-handling equipment safely.
• Strong safety mindset and willingness to follow site procedures, including lift permits and exclusion zones.
• Willingness to work extended hours, nights, and weekends during critical construction windows.
• Prior experience on data center, industrial, or heavy-civil construction sites.
• Familiarity with load charts, pick planning, and mechanical equipment sets (pumps, air handlers, cooling towers, skids).
• NCCCO Rigger certification (Level I or II) or equivalent.
• Qualified signal person certification.
• Forklift certification; aerial lift or scissor lift certification a plus.
• OSHA 10 or equivalent training.
• Ability to read plans, lift sketches, and equipment arrangement drawings.
• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to travel extensively to SpaceXAI data center construction sites and remain onsite during peak construction phases.
• Capability to work in industrial environments, climb ladders, lift and position moderate loads and rigging hardware, stand and walk for a full shift, and wear PPE for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Repairs Lead within the Data Center Infrastructure organization, you will define and manage the end-to-end hardware repair program across Anthropic's growing fleet of data centers. You will be accountable for repair turnaround time and the compute returned to service across every site, covering server, GPU/accelerator, network, and optics break-fix, RMA and reverse logistics with OEMs and ODMs, and the spares and repair inventory that keeps repair SLAs achievable. As a subject matter expert in hardware operations, you will develop scalable repair processes and quality targets, set the standards that site operations partners and repair vendors execute against, and turn failure trends into fixes which are driven upstream with engineering and equipment partners. If you are experienced in at-scale datacenter hardware operations, are passionate about HPC data centers, & enjoy working in complex, fast-paced environments, we welcome you to apply.

Responsibilities Include:

•

Define the global repair strategy including repair SLAs, prioritization rules, escalation paths, and reporting methods, and drive standardization across all sites.

•

Own repair turnaround time and repair backlog across the fleet evidenced by Anthropic-owned ticket and telemetry dashboards you help develop.

•

Author and improve procedures for triage, break-fix, return-to-service validation, and train site operations partners on how to execute them.

•

Manage RMA and reverse logistics programs with OEMs, ODMs, and depot repair vendors, including warranty claims, return cycle times, and failure analysis feedback.

•

Set spares pool sizing and stocking levels by site and part, in coordination with supply chain and asset management, so that parts availability never gates repair SLAs.

•

Analyze failure patterns across sites to identify root causes and drive corrective actions with hardware engineering, suppliers, and site operations owners.

•

Lead the operating cadence with vendor and site leads, including weekly repair reviews, scorecards, and business reviews, and drive corrective actions for SLA excursions.

•

Communicate repair constraints, risks, and fleet availability impact to engineering and leadership.

You may be a good fit if you:

•

Have 8+ years of experience in data center operations as a manager, technical lead or related role, including accountability for production availability.

•

Can demonstrate a proven track record running break-fix programs at a large scale across multiple sites.

•

Have managed vendors, OEMs, or contract workforces to measurable outcomes: SLAs, operational reviews, and corrective action.

•

Possess hands-on technical depth in server, network, and rack-level hardware, enough to independently verify repair quality and audit vendor claims.

•

Have built or substantially improved operational processes.

•

Are comfortable working with ticket, telemetry, and inventory data to drive decisions.

•

Possess a bachelor's degree in relevant domain or equivalent practical experience.

It’s a bonus if you have:

•

Experience with GPU/accelerator or high-density liquid-cooled infrastructure, including tray, cold plate, and manifold-level repair.

•

Experience managing RMA and warranty programs with hyperscale OEMs/ODMs, including failure analysis and supplier quality engagement.

•

Experience with spares planning, reverse logistics, or depot repair at data center scale.

•

Experience delivering repair outcomes inside partner-operated or colocation sites where on-the-floor operations are staffed via third parties.

•

Familiarity with optics and high-speed interconnect failures.

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to retail organisations across the EMEA markets. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with retail brands. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise in the retail sector to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to retail stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities in merchandising, customer experience, and store operations. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with retail decision-makers.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help enterprises obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI.

Responsibilities:

• Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the retail sector. Navigate complex retail organisations to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to close
• Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to retail procurement cycles and budgeting processes to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyze retail market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities and campaigns

• Continuously refine the retail sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimize sales productivity and consistency

You may be a good fit if you have:

• 8+ years of B2B sales experience in SaaS, API solutions, or emerging technologies.

• Demonstrated ability to navigate retail organisational structures and procurement processes, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including executives, administrators, and IT departments

• A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for retail use

£280,000—£330,000 GBP

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

jobs.description: Description de l'entreprise Chez Publicis, on aime faire autrement et redéfinir les règles du jeu. Ici, il y a des motivés qui ne laissent jamais tomber leur équipe, qui se retroussent les manches quand il le faut et qui célèbrent fort les réussites. Chez nous, l’attitude est aussi importante que le talent. On ne craint pas l’échec puisque, pour nous, il n’existe pas. On essaie toutes sortes de choses et si le résultat n’est pas bon, on apprend et on recommence. Pour coller à cette philosophie, nous avons besoin de personnes responsables qui ont le goût de grandir, de s’épanouir et d’accompagner des marques d’ici dans leurs réflexions créatives. Descriptif du poste Le/la Chargé·e de projet senior doit avoir une compréhension solide du processus créatif, du brief jusqu’à la production, afin d’assurer la livraison de projets dans les délais et selon le budget. En collaboration avec les gestionnaires de comptes dans un environnement de production, il/elle contribuera à piloter les échéanciers, les ressources et les flux de travail pour divers projets numériques : bannières, publicités sociales, sites Web, séances photo. La personne se concentrera sur le flux de travail de bout en bout, la qualité de la livraison, l’efficacité opérationnelle, la gestion des risques et la résolution rapide des enjeux. Responsabilités Gérer et mobiliser des équipes multidisciplinaires dans un environnement rapide et multi‑projets. Coordonner principalement la maintenance de sites Web de premier niveau. Gérer également de plus petits projets de l’initiation à la planification, conception, développement, tests et maintenance. Suivre de manière proactive l’avancement du travail afin d’assurer l’efficacité des tâches et d’éliminer les obstacles. Anticiper les besoins du client tout au long du processus d’implantation et de maintenance. Assurer les communications quotidiennes et maintenir d’excellentes relations avec les clients et partenaires. Contribuer à la création de documentation de projet : cahiers des charges, briefs, échéanciers, suivis de statut, estimations, etc. Collaborer avec l’équipe de gestion de projet pour identifier et résoudre les conflits ou lacunes de ressources de façon efficace et rentable. Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec toutes les parties prenantes et les tenir régulièrement informées du statut des projets. Suivre et réconcilier le temps réel vs. estimé pour une précision budgétaire optimale et une récupération maximale des heures. Produire un rapport budgétaire hebdomadaire. Sens exceptionnel de l’organisation, souci du détail et grande motivation. Personne assertive, proactive et capable de travailler en équipe. Capacité d’adaptation, multitâche et à l’aise avec de nouveaux défis. Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en prise de décision. Capacité à organiser, prioriser et respecter les échéances. Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément tout en demeurant structuré·e. Qualifications 4+ années d’expérience en gestion de projet numérique, spécifiquement en publicité et marketing pharmaceutiques. Compréhension des méthodologies, concepts et processus de production Web. Expérience en livraison ou participation à des projets numériques : bannières, publicités sociales, sites Web, séances photo. Capacité à mobiliser et gérer des équipes pour atteindre des résultats exceptionnels. Connaissance des outils de gestion de projet / tâches (MS Project, Asana, JIRA, etc.). Intérêt marqué pour le numérique/interactif et capacité à identifier des opportunités d’innovation. Excellentes compétences en présentation.
